summary: One large paragraph of two to four sentences that the reader inks in by scrolling: every word starts pale and turns to full colour, word by word, as the section passes up the screen. Optional small label above, a short attribution line under it (who says this, for example the founder and their role) and a link. Use right after the hero or the logos for a mission or point-of-view statement; reduced motion shows it in full at once.
